stages.event: You trudge through the knee-deep snow, the biting wind whipping your face with icy gusts. As you reach the top of a ridge, a breathtaking view of the Glacier unfurls before you: towering ice formations stretch towards the gray sky, glinting with frosty crystals.

choices.1: Use your strength (ATT) to push through the drift and reach the foot of the glacier.
choices.2: Use your agility (DEX) to navigate the treacherous slope without slipping.
choices.3: Use your endurance (ENE) to withstand the biting cold and press on.

stages.event: You're now standing at the foot of the glacier, surrounded by the eerie silence of the frozen wasteland. The air is crystal clear, but the wind whispers a mournful sigh through the crystal formations, sending shivers down your spine. In the distance, you spot a herd of arctic reindeer grazing on the sparse, icy lichens.

choices.1: Use your physical prowess (ATT) to examine the glacier up close and search for any hidden crevices or fissures.
choices.2: Use your keen senses (DEX) to survey the area and spot any potential dangers or hidden obstacles.
choices.3: Use your patience (ENE) to observe the reindeer, perhaps learning something valuable from these creatures adapted to the harsh environment.

stages.event: A fierce polar bear blocks your path through the Glacier! It looks aggressive and territorial, its fur fluffed out by the cold air.

choices.1: Stand your ground and intimidate the bear (ATT) with a fierce roar.
choices.2: Use your cunning (DEX) to distract the bear by tossing a nearby rock or chunk of ice.
choices.3: Maintain your calm and assert your dominance (ENE), trying to calm the bear down.

stages.event: A speeding wolverine charges at you across the Glacier, its eyes fixed on you as it gains speed!

choices.1: Use your agility to outmaneuver the wolverine with swift movements (ATT).
choices.2: Use your quick reflexes to dodgy the wolverine by leaping or dodging at the right moment (DEX).
choices.3: Withstand the chase, focusing your energy to maintain a steady pace (ENE).

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You come across a wooden chest partially hidden by a wall of ice formations. The chest seems to shift slightly, giving an unnerving feeling as if it's not quite as stationary as it appears.

choices.1: Unleash your physical strength (ATT) and force the chest open.
choices.2: Use your sharp wits (DEX) to carefully examine the chest for any hidden traps or weaknesses.
choices.3: Patience and caution are key here (ENE), perhaps there's a hidden mechanism to open the chest without triggering it.

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You come across a genuine treasure chest nestled between crystal formations. A subtle sparkle emanates from the lock, hinting at potential wonders within.

choices.1: Use your force to open the lock (ATT).
choices.2: Tackle the lock head-on using your problem-solving skills (DEX). Choose to either 1 or 2 to attempt to open the double loot chest
choices.3: Search the area with keen eyesight (ENE) to find any hidden keys or clues.

stages.event: With the treasure safely in hand, you feel a sense of accomplishment and relief as you step away from the frozen wasteland, the wind now blowing gently behind you.

choices.1: Take a confident last look (ATT) before departing.
choices.2: Show respect for this unforgiving realm (DEX) by performing a quiet, meaningful gesture.
choices.3: Leave with a hearty laugh and the memories (ENE) of your adventure, already looking forward to the next challenge.
